E1_phix.comparison: One fixed non-anatomical grouping versus anatomical grouping at the same configured token and codeword budgets.

E2_phix.comparison: Equal stored codewords and code dimension, not equal token count or nominal bit budget.

E2_csl.comparison: Equal stored codewords and code dimension, not equal token count or nominal bit budget.

data.sample_schema: Dictionary keyed by sample ID, each value contains text and poses_3d[T,178,3]. Existing gloss fields are not used by these training objectives.

execution_notes: Each command selects one dataset, variant, seed and stage. Run seeds42/43/44 separately.
tokenize includes interleaving and source-length/truncation annotation. Do not train AR on the raw unannotated cache.
VQ training uses CUDA. Reconstruction evaluation has a separate CPU constructor compatibility path.
Generation and backtranslation are separate tools, not implicitly executed by the ar stage.
